set.body:
Objective
Make group_analysis.Rmd deterministic and ensure every displayed group-level result computes the stated estimand.

Required work
- Reproduce and fix the invocation-sensitive failure in the meta-engine chunk.
- Replace the nonexistent group contrast coefficient with the actual model coefficient or a programmatic exact match.
- Stop blanket warning suppression from hiding missing coefficients and weighting fallbacks.
- Investigate and explain or correct the spatial-FDR example that reports 75 discoveries for 27 true active voxels.
- Ensure returned method metadata identifies the requested combination method.

Acceptance criteria
- The vignette renders successfully in at least five consecutive fresh R sessions.
- The post-hoc group contrast is nonzero and agrees with the known simulated group difference within a declared tolerance.
- No missing-coefficient warning occurs.
- Any equal-weight fallback is either eliminated or deliberately demonstrated and explained.
- Tests cover the exact coefficient name, contrast value, method metadata, and the clean-render regression.
set.title: Stabilize group-analysis rendering and restore valid group contrasts
